# How to Scrape LinkedIn in 2026: Profiles, Jobs, Companies
## Is scraping LinkedIn legal in 2026?
**hiQ Labs v. LinkedIn (9th Circuit, 2022)** — The court ruled that scraping publicly accessible data is not a violation of the CFAA. "Without authorization" in the CFAA applies to bypassing technical access barriers (passwords, authentication), not to reading pages anyone can open
